children: Ola Electric Mobility shares fell over 9 percent in Friday's trading session, snapping a four-day gaining streak, ahead of the company's board meeting to consider a fundraise.
Shares of Ola Electric Mobility fell more than 9 percent to Rs 38.60 per share on the NSE.
The decline came after the company's shares rose more than 16 percent in the previous four trading sessions.

The fall also came after Ola Electric announced earlier this week that its board will meet on September 28 to consider a proposal to raise funds through a rights issue of equity shares, subject to requisite regulatory and statutory approvals.

The electric two-wheeler maker informed the stock exchanges that the board will consider the proposed fundraise under Regulation 29(1)(d) of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) Listing Regulations.
The proposed rights issue comes months after Ola Electric raised Rs 780 crore through a qualified institutional placement (QIP) in June. The issue was oversubscribed by 56 percent.
